purpose: Compose Aether's portable repository-continuity contract into an organization applicability, migration, exception, and rollout policy without redefining its schema, template, skill, or provider projections.

upstream.activation_gate: Aether must mark the pinned contract and skill stable and releasable, and a maintainer must accept ADR-008, before Hygiene advances beyond observe.

required_files.content_rule: Preserve repository-authored instructions and maintain exactly one pinned Aether continuity block that reads the checkpoint before work and refreshes it after validation and before pull-request presentation.
Repository-specific current evidence is required; untouched template placeholders and generic boilerplate do not satisfy the policy.
Generated from a pinned Hygiene revision; repository-specific continuity prose remains outside this projection.

initial_scope.catalog_reconciliation: The 2026-08-21 architecture catalog is a separate stale inventory input; scope is pinned to the reviewed 29-repository issue snapshot until the catalog-refresh quest lands.

stages.entry_gate: The proposed Hygiene profile and immutable Aether pin are reviewable.
stages.exit_gate: Aether is stable and releasable, ADR-008 is accepted, and representative public and private pilots produce reviewable evidence.
stages.rollback: Keep repository files, stop policy promotion, and repin the prior immutable repository-context/v1 contract.

stages.entry_gate: Observe exit evidence is accepted and downstream validators consume the same immutable policy.
stages.exit_gate: Every active repository is conformant or has a reviewed, unexpired exception visible in validation.
stages.rollback: Return to observe, preserve evidence and repository-owned checkpoints, and stop blocking regressions.

stages.entry_gate: Ratchet exit evidence is accepted and enforcement rollback has been exercised.
stages.exit_gate: Superseded only by a reviewed policy successor with migration guidance.
stages.rollback: Return to ratchet through a reviewed policy change; do not delete checkpoint history or fabricate conformance.

compatibility.reason: Root CONTINUITY.md and repository-owned managed AGENTS.md content become mandatory for active consumers.
compatibility.migration: Pin v1 until the repository adopts the root checkpoint and managed instruction block in one reviewed pull request, then pin v2.
compatibility.deprecation: Do not select v1 for new consumers. Retain its frozen artifact and schema while any reviewed consumer remains pinned.
compatibility.rollback: Repin the immutable v1 artifact and return enforcement to observe; preserve repository-owned CONTINUITY.md unless a separate reviewed repository change removes it.

downstream.responsibility: Deterministic structural conformance, normalized findings, and visible exception state without asserting semantic truth.
Materialize pinned root files and reconcile exactly one managed instruction block while preserving repository prose.
Run reusable local preflight and read-only pull-request CI; never author semantic handoff prose in CI.
Observe privacy-safe conformance metadata without collecting CONTINUITY.md prose.
Propose dependency-aware, reversible fleet adoption pull requests pinned to released inputs.

ownership.aether: Owns the portable continuity specification, schema, template, skill semantics, dispositions, and provider projections at the immutable upstream revision.
ownership.hygiene: Owns organization applicability, required-file composition, rollout stages, migration, exception policy, and contract lifecycle without copying Aether semantics.
ownership.egolint: Owns deterministic conformance diagnostics and report normalization.
ownership.holon: Owns new-repository materialization and managed-block reconciliation.
ownership.relay: Owns reusable validation execution and report transport.
ownership.pace: Owns reviewable convergence proposals for existing repositories.
ownership.repository: Owns its current-state wording, redaction choices, exceptions, reconciliation, and final pull-request review.
